name: archived_conversations
create:
CREATE TABLE archived_conversations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: command_receipts
create:
CREATE TABLE command_receipts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: conversations
create:
CREATE TABLE conversations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.revision') END) STORED, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT conversation_identity CHECK (json_valid(payload) AND json_extract(payload, '$.id') = id), 
	CONSTRAINT conversation_revision CHECK (revision >= 0)
)

name: creation_jobs
create:
CREATE TABLE creation_jobs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_started VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: devices
create:
CREATE TABLE devices (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	token_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT device_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','revoked')), 
	UNIQUE (token_sha256)
)

name: evaluations
create:
CREATE TABLE evaluations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: execution_budgets
create:
CREATE TABLE execution_budgets (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	max_calls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_calls INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT budget_calls CHECK (max_calls > 0 AND reserved_calls BETWEEN 0 AND max_calls)
)

name: image_submissions
create:
CREATE TABLE image_submissions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: images
create:
CREATE TABLE images (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.state') END) STORED, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT image_identity CHECK (json_valid(payload) AND json_extract(payload, '$.run_id') = id)
)

name: objects
create:
CREATE TABLE objects (
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sha256), 
	CONSTRAINT object_digest CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND size_bytes >= 0)
)

name: preferences
create:
CREATE TABLE preferences (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT preferences_singleton CHECK (id = 1 AND json_valid(payload))
)

name: preset_saves
create:
CREATE TABLE preset_saves (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: presets
create:
CREATE TABLE presets (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_player ON presets (kind) WHERE kind='player' AND deleted=0

name: archived_operations
create:
CREATE TABLE archived_operations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request TEXT NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	owner_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_started VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	base_revision INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES archived_conversations (id)
)

name: artifact_bindings
create:
CREATE TABLE artifact_bindings (
	"key" TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sha256) REFERENCES objects (sha256)
)

name: conversation_bookmarks
create:
CREATE TABLE conversation_bookmarks (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT bookmark_json CHECK (json_valid(payload)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

name: conversation_events
create:
CREATE TABLE conversation_events (
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	pending INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, kind, id), 
	CONSTRAINT event_pending CHECK (pending IN (0,1) AND json_valid(payload)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_conversation_events_current ON conversation_events (conversation_id, pending)

name: conversation_turns
create:
CREATE TABLE conversation_turns (
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turn_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	prefix_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT turn_position CHECK (position >= 0 AND json_valid(payload)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_turn_identity UNIQUE (conversation_id, turn_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

name: device_events
create:
CREATE TABLE device_events (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT device_event_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','revoked')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_device_events_device ON device_events (device_id, recorded_at)

name: llm_records
create:
CREATE TABLE llm_records (
	operation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (operation_id, purpose, attempt, revision), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_record_position CHECK (attempt >= 0 AND revision >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sha256) REFERENCES objects (sha256)
)

name: operations
create:
CREATE TABLE operations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request TEXT NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	active_slot INTEGER, 
	owner_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_started VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	base_revision INTEGER, 
	state VARCHAR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN json_valid(payload) THEN json_extract(payload, '$.state') END) STORED, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT operation_json CHECK (json_valid(request) AND json_valid(payload)), 
	CONSTRAINT operation_identity CHECK (json_extract(payload, '$.id') = id AND json_extract(payload, '$.conversation_id') = conversation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT operation_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted','running','complete','failed','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT operation_slot CHECK (active_slot IS NULL OR active_slot = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT operation_owner CHECK (owner_pid > 0 AND (base_revision IS NULL OR base_revision >= 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	UNIQUE (active_slot)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_operations_conversation ON operations (conversation_id, state)
